description: Turn off termination protection for a Cube. After this call, `delete_cube` works normally again. Idempotent: unprotecting an already-unprotected Cube is a no-op server-side. To turn protection back on, call `protect_cube`.

cubeId.description: The Cube id to operate on.

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.

name: unprotect_cube
title: Unprotect Cube
